lines.lyric: Modeun geol ireobeorindaedo sanggwan eopseo
lines.lyric_hangul: 모든 걸 잃어버린대도 상관 없어
lines.lyric_translation: Even if I lose everything, I don’t care

lines.lyric: Jigeum i gamjeongi sunganira haedo
lines.lyric_hangul: 지금 이 감정이 순간이라 해도
lines.lyric_translation: Even if these emotions right now are fleeting

lines.lyric: Ijeneun deo isang nae mam sumgigin shireo
lines.lyric_hangul: 이제는 더 이상 내 맘 숨기긴 싫어
lines.lyric_translation: I don’t want to hide my feelings anymore

lines.lyric: Ne nunbichi nal jayuropge mandeuljana
lines.lyric_hangul: 네 눈빛이 날 자유롭게 만들잖아
lines.lyric_translation: The look in your eyes sets me free

lines.lyric_hangul: No-no-no-no-no, 의식하지 말고
lines.lyric_translation: No No No No No / Don’t be conscious of it, just embrace me

lines.lyric_hangul: 날 안아줘, 더는 잃을 것도 숨길 것도 없어
lines.lyric_translation: There’s nothing left to lose, / Nothing left to hide

lines.lyric_hangul: 내 모든 걸 걸어, risk it all, 이 사랑 말고는 fade out
lines.lyric_translation: I’ll bet everything I have, risk it all / Everything except for this love, fade out
